About.heading: About
About.profileParagraph1: I'm {grade} living in Tokyo. I build websites and Discord bots, and run my own servers.
About.profileParagraph2: I started programming in sixth grade, when I first came across ChatGPT. By asking AI whenever I got stuck, the list of things I could build kept growing.
About.profileParagraph3: I love tinkering with servers and networks, and I now run six servers across VPSes and machines at home. I also run my own AS on dn42, operate a public time server anyone can use, and pick up aircraft positions with an antenna at home.
About.profileParagraph4: When I build something, I start with a small version that works, then keep improving it as I use it.
